    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CameraManager
    Applies the configured movement speed and view settings to the engine camera.
    ChunkLoader
    Streams terrain chunks around the camera, generating mesh data asynchronously and installing scene-graph objects on the render thread.
    CloudManager
    Renders a deterministic volumetric cloud layer and updates its motion and lighting.
    CloudNoiseGenerator
    Builds seamless cloud-noise data on the CPU.
    GameConfig
    Immutable, validated runtime settings loaded from the external config.xml document.
    LightingManager
    Owns the scene's directional sun and ambient light and provides shared sun state.
    LoggingConfiguration
    Initializes file logging and optional console logging before the engine starts.
    Main
    Application entry point for the desktop OpenWorld demo.
    PerlinNoise
    Seeded Perlin noise backed by JME-FastNoise.
    ProceduralTextureGenerator
    Generates diffuse and normal textures from TextureDefinition layers.
    SkyManager
    Creates and updates the sky gradient and visible sun using the shared lighting direction.
    TerrainChunk
    Renderable terrain chunk assembled from worker-generated mesh data.
    TerrainChunk.Data
    Buffers and sampled heights produced by terrain generation for later mesh assembly.
    TerrainGenerator
    Generates deterministic terrain heights, surface weights, and vegetation-placement fields from a single world seed.
    TerrainManager
    Terrain facade used by Main.java and other modules to coordinate procedural materials, chunk streaming, wind-driven vegetation, and world reseeding.
    TextureDefinition
    Immutable description of a procedural terrain texture loaded from textures.xml.
    TextureDefinition.Layer
    Immutable settings for one XML <layer> contribution.
    TextureDefinition.LayerType
    Supported noise contributions that can be combined in a diffuse or normal map.
    TextureDefinition.MapSpec
    Settings and ordered noise layers for one diffuse or normal map.
    TextureLibrary
    Loads the procedural texture catalog from the classpath and caches generated textures for the current world seed.
    WaterManager
    Configures and updates the jMonkeyEngine water filter and its post-processing pipeline.
    WindModel
    Smooth, deterministic wind variation used to drive water waves.
    WorldScene
    Root scene node that initializes, updates, and tears down the world rendering systems while sharing a single source of sun state.
